svg.title: Serial loop versus indo in parallel
svg.desc: Schematic of 8 equal repos. Plain bash runs them one after another. indo -P 8 runs them at once. In 172 plain bash runs the agent did this in parallel 2 times, both git fetch, never tests. Real suites are uneven, so the measured all-tests speedup is 3.3x, not 8x.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One loop, or all at once
